rules: Headings should use Work Sans, tightly tracked.
Use IBM Plex Mono for all flight data, waypoints, altitudes, fuel numbers, etc.
Strict light theme with high contrast to mimic EFB (Electronic Flight Bag) software.
Aviation blue (primary) and magenta (accent) for route indicators.
Background should be off-white (slate-50) to reduce glare, surfaces pure white with crisp 1px borders.

layouts.app_container: Flex column with Top Navigation Bar, followed by main content area. Do not center-align.
layouts.dashboard: Dense list or bento grid for saved flights, showcasing origin/dest, aircraft, and block times.
layouts.flight_detail: Modular panels: Header summary, Fuel planning card, Navlog Table. Use dense padding for tables.
layouts.navlog_table: Dense border-collapse table. Right-align numeric values. Use monospaced font for all data columns.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing around containers (p-8 or p-12), but dense spacing within data tables (p-2 to p-3).

components.buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-sm) buttons. Primary buttons use aviation blue. Avoid pill shapes for EFB.
components.cards: Flat, rectangular, subtle 1px border. No drop shadows. Use border-slate-200.
components.tables: Crisp borders, dense layout, sticky headers. Hover states on rows.

motion.rules: Minimalist. Micro-interactions for hover states. No bouncy animations. Immediate, precise feedback.

accessibility.data-testid: All interactive elements and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust layout: A Top navbar containing Logo, My Flights, SimBrief Profile, and Auth (Logout).
Add the required fonts (Work Sans, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono) via Google Fonts in index.html.
Install and use a suitable icon library like lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react for aviation icons (plane, map-pin, wind, gas-pump).
Dashboard page: A list showing imported flights. A prominent button to 'Import latest OFP from SimBrief'.
Flight Detail page: The core of the app. Layout: Top summary header (callsign, routing, ETE). Fuel card. Main section for the Navlog table.
Navlog table: Must include Waypoint, Airway, FL, Wind, TAS, GS, Dist, ETE, ETA, FOB, Fuel Burn. Add a checkbox or toggle for 'Live in-flight tracker' to tick off waypoints as you pass them.
Design aesthetic: Very clean, dense, technical. Flat borders, no shadows. Professional aviation EFB style.
Provide a 'Export Navlog as PDF' button (can be mocked with window.print() or UI trigger).
For SimBrief integration, provide a mock form on the Settings page to enter 'Pilot ID' and mock API logic to fetch a dummy OFP.
Make sure all components use pure Tailwind CSS and do not rely on missing complex Shadcn components if they are not pre-installed. You can build pure HTML/Tailwind tables for the Navlog.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
DO NOT apply universal transition like 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms.
DO NOT center align the app container. Remove text-align: center from App.css. It disrupts the human natural reading flow.
Always use modern precise styles relevant to the app style.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use generous spacing for main layout, but dense spacing for data tables.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) using kebab-case role-based names.
